newsitem.title: SPAIN: Firm hand boosts Spain bourse confidence - watchdog.
newsitem.headline: Firm hand boosts Spain bourse confidence - watchdog.

text.p: Spain's stock market commission CNMV said its firm stance gives credibility to and boosts the success of privatisations, chairman Juan Fernandez-Armesto told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.
The CNMV told electricity company Endesa in October that it was starting legal proceedings against it for failing to inform it about plans to buy regional utilities Sevillana and Fecsa.

In response to a question regarding the CNMV's move to sanction Endesa, Fernandez-Armesto said "These are actions by the commission that increase the attractiveness of the Spanish market for investors and subsequently, facilitate the placement of shares with investors."
Part of the state's 66 percent stake in Endesa is due to be sold on the stock market later this year.
CNMV said Endesa informed them of its bid for the two firms only after it had signed deals with both, on October 17.
On October 10, it told the CNMV it had no "concrete plans" for the purchases.
